name: Maxton Hall: The World Between Us
s: When Ruby unwillingly witnesses an explosive secret at Maxton Hall Private School, arrogant millionaire heir James Beaufort is forced to confront the quick-witted scholarship student, much to his chagrin: He is determined to silence Ruby. paragraphs.text: Maxton Hall—The World Between Us () is a German television series on Amazon Prime Video. It is based on the 2018 novel Save Me by . It stars Damian Hardung as James Beaufort and Harriet Herbig-Matten as Ruby Bell. The series premiered on May 9, 2024, and had the most successful series launch of any non-American Prime Original ever, becoming the most popular series on Prime Video worldwide shortly after its release by ranking #1 in the charts in over 120 regions.
In June 2025, the series was renewed for a third and final season which is slated to premiere on December 9, 2026.
For the first season, the review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes reported a 70% critics rating based on 10 reviews, with an average rating of 4.5/10.
